independence_statement: all predictors and model structures were frozen before formal mechanism association/model results were inspected
prior_outcome_knowledge: 06–15 descriptive outcomes and prior QA known; not outcome-blind preregistration. No formal mechanism associations inspected.

primary_outcome.definition: mean_i abs(mean_slots C(L)-mean_hours C(anchor)); pool 153 dates equally

secondary_outcome.name: mean_delta_ug_m3
secondary_outcome.formal_model: NO FORMAL SIGNED-DELTA MECHANISM MODEL IN PAPER 1

mobility_cohort.definition: All main-anchor-valid rows among frozen raw IDs; not filtered by O3 support
mobility_cohort.source_rule: No O3 values or support masks in mobility predictor generation
mobility_cohort.denominator_mismatch: Known only in fixed-mask cities; report, then remove all three in support sensitivity

o3_support.definition: Unique mapped ChinaHighO3 (iy,ix) cells from all released WorldMove grids with complete fixed 153x24 support
o3_support.weights: equal unique product cells; no visits/anchor/population weights
o3_support.hour_aggregation: spatial dispersion at each hour then average 24 hours
o3_support.mapping: frozen nearest-axis, lower-coordinate tie, no interpolation
o3_support.cell_count_below_two_action: Stop and audit; no silent city exclusion

final_temporal_alignment_predictor.name: alignment_excess_iqr_ug_m3
final_temporal_alignment_predictor.flat_profiles: A=0 if M or H constant
final_temporal_alignment_predictor.sensitivity: Same formula with P90-P10; no alternate alignment algorithm

between_city_model.fit: OLS, equal city weights, raw outcome
between_city_model.standardization: 33-city mean/SD ddof=1; report raw and standardized, not separate fits

within_city_model.fit: OLS city fixed effects / equivalent explicit demeaning
within_city_model.centering: Each predictor minus its own city equal-date 153-day mean
within_city_model.standardization: Pooled within-centered predictor SD; not per-city SD scaling

month_handling: Descriptive stratification; nuisance FE only in joint background/calendar sensitivity; not mechanism

footprint_handling.qa_only: unique valid O3 cells and mapping ratio

mean_o3_handling.definition: U_ct=mean_h(mean_unique_cells(C)); pool or within-center by model

robustness_set.name: high_confidence
robustness_set.change: Recompute mobility and A using dominance>=0.75; use existing high-confidence Y; fixed O3 support

robustness_set.name: alternate_dispersion
robustness_set.change: Replace IQR with P90-P10 throughout H and A; never add both

robustness_set.name: leave_one_city_out
robustness_set.change: Between influence/held-city errors and within held-city temporal anomaly predictions; no held-city intercept

robustness_set.name: geometry
robustness_set.change: Between primary + log(released grid count); no within geometry slope

robustness_set.name: fixed_mask
robustness_set.change: Repeat both primary models on remaining 30 cities

robustness_set.name: background_calendar
robustness_set.change: Between primary + Ubar; within primary + Uw + 4 month dummies jointly

xgboost.scientific_role: Constrained secondary nonlinear/interaction prediction test; no causal or between-city mechanism claim
xgboost.version: Record installed version at execution; no installation or fit this round

grouped_cv_strategy.preprocessing: Train cities only for scaling/model fitting; full-window test X centering allowed, explicitly retrospective; no test Y in prediction
grouped_cv_strategy.generalization_target: Unseen released cities with known complete 2019 May-September O3 fields; not unseen dates or independent regions
grouped_cv_strategy.linear_baseline: OLS Y ~ 1 + T + E + Hbar + Hw + Aw, same five features, no city fitted intercept
grouped_cv_strategy.temporal_scoring: Demean held-out predictions and targets separately for scoring only; never add test target mean to predictions
stable_increment_conditions: macro-MAE improvement direction survives deletion of each one saved city score
grouped_cv_strategy.failed_increment: Retain brief negative result/performance audit in supplement; remove elaborate nonlinear interpretation; no model search
grouped_cv_strategy.main_text_promotion: Not allowed under current SUPPLEMENT_ONLY freeze

SHAP_interpretation_boundary: No SHAP in this design. Any future amended SHAP would describe predictions only, never causal mechanism or feature retention.

degeneracy_protocol.constant_predictor: Record non-estimable, omit only constant computation column; no replacement
degeneracy_protocol.rank_failure: Stop affected model and version amendment; do not outcome-select alternative
degeneracy_protocol.VIF_gt_5: Flag coefficient separability; no variable dropping/search

types: D: robust limited explanation, no causal residual attribution
E: no stable ML increment, simple model retained
success_criteria.direction_stability_reporting: At least 27/33 LOCO slope signs agree; no one-city removal changes coefficient by more than absolute full-model coefficient; near-zero/wide CI remains uncertain

reframe_conditions: core relations unstable across LOCO/input sensitivities
no transfer beyond unseen-city baselines: withdraw transfer claim

time_away_fraction.exact_definition: Fraction of all 48 slots away from main anchor, over all anchor-valid frozen IDs, including stationary schedules.
time_away_fraction.input_source: WorldMove traj/grid + frozen formal IDs + main anchor rule; all anchor-valid IDs; no O3 or outcome read
time_away_fraction.circularity_risk: Not circular; shared synthetic input with outcome
time_away_fraction.rationale: Time opportunity separated from away-conditional distance.
time_away_fraction.known_limitation: Synthetic grid-level absence, not observed residents; differs from complete-pair denominator in three mask cities.

mean_away_distance_km.exact_definition: Away-slot-weighted mean anchor distance; haversine on grid centroids, Earth radius 6371.0088 km; zero if no away slots, with structural flag.
mean_away_distance_km.input_source: WorldMove traj/grid + frozen formal IDs + main anchor rule; all anchor-valid IDs; no O3 or outcome read
mean_away_distance_km.rationale: Linear distance opportunity without reintroducing time-away zeros.
mean_away_distance_km.known_limitation: Longer away durations receive more weight; mean remains tail-sensitive; not road length.

hourly_away_fraction.exact_definition: Two half-hour away indicators averaged across anchor-valid schedules, each hour 0..23 GMT+8; fixed across dates.
hourly_away_fraction.input_source: WorldMove traj/grid + frozen formal IDs + main anchor rule; all anchor-valid IDs; no O3 or outcome read
hourly_away_fraction.rationale: Intermediate profile for alignment only, not 24 fitted features.
hourly_away_fraction.known_limitation: No real calendar-date mobility or weekday label.

hourly_spatial_iqr.exact_definition: For each date and hour, linear/type-7 Q75 minus Q25 over unique valid mapped product cells; date is an additional key.
hourly_spatial_iqr.input_source: ChinaHighO3 formal raw-field cache + fixed release-to-product mapping/mask; unique valid product cells; no trajectory weighting
hourly_spatial_iqr.known_limitation: IQR may miss tail contrasts; city_hour schema has additional date key; not ground-truth gradient.

daily_spatial_iqr.exact_definition: Arithmetic mean of all 24 hourly spatial IQR values, not IQR of daily mean field.
daily_spatial_iqr.input_source: ChinaHighO3 formal raw-field cache + fixed release-to-product mapping/mask; unique valid product cells; no trajectory weighting
daily_spatial_iqr.circularity_risk: Shared product but no algebraic reconstruction
daily_spatial_iqr.known_limitation: Does not encode spatial arrangement or gradient orientation.

pooled_spatial_iqr.exact_definition: Equal-date mean of daily spatial IQR over all frozen 153 days.
pooled_spatial_iqr.input_source: ChinaHighO3 formal raw-field cache + fixed release-to-product mapping/mask; unique valid product cells; no trajectory weighting
pooled_spatial_iqr.known_limitation: Release area and product smoothing affect scale.

alignment_excess_iqr_ug_m3.exact_definition: Mobility-weighted hourly IQR minus unweighted daily hourly IQR; if T=0 set 0 and flag; no epsilon or profile-SD division.
alignment_excess_iqr_ug_m3.input_source: WorldMove traj/grid + frozen formal IDs + main anchor rule; all anchor-valid IDs; no O3 or outcome read + ChinaHighO3 formal raw-field cache + fixed release-to-product mapping/mask; unique valid product cells; no trajectory weighting
alignment_excess_iqr_ug_m3.circularity_risk: Shared-product/scaling dependence; no visited-minus-anchor contrast; not guaranteed association
alignment_excess_iqr_ug_m3.rationale: Time co-occurrence excess beyond daily contrast level.
alignment_excess_iqr_ug_m3.known_limitation: Not pure phase or direction; H and A need not be empirically independent.

within_spatial_iqr.exact_definition: Equal-date within-city centering of daily_spatial_iqr over the fixed complete 153-day window.
within_spatial_iqr.input_source: ChinaHighO3 formal raw-field cache + fixed release-to-product mapping/mask; unique valid product cells; no trajectory weighting
within_spatial_iqr.circularity_risk: No outcome centering used in predictor
within_spatial_iqr.rationale: Separates within from between; replaces raw daily column in model.
within_spatial_iqr.known_limitation: Full-window retrospective feature, not real-time forecasting; not an extra independent feature.

within_alignment_excess.exact_definition: Equal-date within-city centering of alignment_excess_iqr_ug_m3 over the fixed complete 153-day window.
within_alignment_excess.input_source: WorldMove traj/grid + frozen formal IDs + main anchor rule; all anchor-valid IDs; no O3 or outcome read + ChinaHighO3 formal raw-field cache + fixed release-to-product mapping/mask; unique valid product cells; no trajectory weighting
within_alignment_excess.circularity_risk: No outcome centering used in predictor
within_alignment_excess.rationale: Separates within from between; replaces raw daily column in model.
within_alignment_excess.known_limitation: Full-window retrospective feature, not real-time forecasting; not an extra independent feature.

spatial_p90_p10.exact_definition: Compute hourly Q90-Q10, then mean over 24 hours; pool dates for between model and center for within model.
spatial_p90_p10.input_source: ChinaHighO3 formal raw-field cache + fixed release-to-product mapping/mask; unique valid product cells; no trajectory weighting
spatial_p90_p10.rationale: Only alternate dispersion; replace IQR rather than add.
spatial_p90_p10.known_limitation: More sensitive to tails and small support.

alignment_excess_p90_p10.exact_definition: Same alignment formula using hourly P90-P10; center within city; not a second alignment algorithm.
alignment_excess_p90_p10.input_source: WorldMove traj/grid + frozen formal IDs + main anchor rule; all anchor-valid IDs; no O3 or outcome read + ChinaHighO3 formal raw-field cache + fixed release-to-product mapping/mask; unique valid product cells; no trajectory weighting
alignment_excess_p90_p10.known_limitation: Same support and co-occurrence limitations as primary A.

footprint_mean_o3.exact_definition: Equal valid product-cell mean per hour, averaged over 24 hours; pool for between, within-center for within.
footprint_mean_o3.input_source: ChinaHighO3 formal raw-field cache + fixed release-to-product mapping/mask; unique valid product cells; no trajectory weighting
footprint_mean_o3.rationale: Assess background level without mistaking it for spatial redistribution.
footprint_mean_o3.known_limitation: Adding uniform concentration changes U but not Delta; not automatically a confounder.

log_released_grid_count.exact_definition: Natural logarithm of released grid_cells in frozen frame; no outcome-based threshold.
log_released_grid_count.rationale: One support-size proxy; only additional geometry slope.
log_released_grid_count.known_limitation: Not population, urban form, true area or complete geometry adjustment.

unique_valid_o3_cell_count.exact_definition: Count unique (iy,ix) mapped cells with full fixed support; QA/reporting only, never a slope.
unique_valid_o3_cell_count.known_limitation: Cell count is not independent spatial sample size.

calendar_month.exact_definition: May-September calendar category; descriptive stratification; four dummies only in joint background/calendar sensitivity.
calendar_month.circularity_risk: Not circular; calendar does not indicate mobility change
calendar_month.known_limitation: No city-by-month interactions; can remove meaningful O3 seasonal information.
